text.p: -- Hambrecht & Quist raised its rating on shares of NACT Telecommunications Inc to strong buy from buy.

-- In a statement, Hambrecht & Quist said it believes the company's STX switching device is well positioned to take advantage of deregulation in telecommunications markets, and the investment company also sees potential for STX overseas.
-- NACT also targets growth markets for international call back and reorigination, prepaid cards and one plus dialing.
-- Finally, Hambrecht & Quist said it remains confident the company will meet or exceed March quarter earnings estimates of $0.08 per share on revenues of $5.9 million.
